variance_questions.training_run: O is C0's own checkpoint in every contrast with C0 / RIC0, so O's training variance is absent from it; the heads come from one LLR run per seed (not measured); F_O / F read against the C0REP floor
variance_questions.inference: LFO100 and LF100 are deterministic. The noise arms carry ONE noise draw (one generator seed 20261106, the same draws at both seeds): a difference between noise levels smaller than a second draw would show is not resolved; sigma* is reported, never deciding
